# Twin Space Studio

> Residential and commercial interior design studio based in Mahalunge, Baner, Pune, India, serving Pune and Pimpri-Chinchwad (PCMC). Full-service design, turnkey execution and styling, typically 10-12 weeks from concept to completion, quoted line by line before work begins.

Founded by Pooja Dhoot and Dimple Marathe. A full 2 BHK interior runs INR 12-16 lakh and a full 3 BHK INR 16-21 lakh; 4 BHK and duplex projects are quoted on scope. The figure quoted on day one is the figure at handover. Work runs through six stages: Discover, Conceptualize, Design & plan, Select & finalize, Execute, Deliver & stylize.

## Services

- [Turnkey interior design and execution](https://twinspacestudios.com/services/turnkey-interiors): one contract covering design, materials, procurement, all site work, supervision and handover.
- [Modular kitchen design](https://twinspacestudios.com/services/modular-kitchens): layouts, shutter materials, counters, internal storage and ventilation.
- [Wardrobes and storage](https://twinspacestudios.com/services/wardrobes-storage): sliding versus openable, internal layouts, bespoke furniture and customized beds.
- [False ceilings and lighting](https://twinspacestudios.com/services/false-ceilings-lighting): gypsum and slatted ceilings, cove and profile lighting, smart home wiring.
- [2 BHK interior design in Pune](https://twinspacestudios.com/services/2-bhk-interior-design): what a full 2 BHK costs and where the budget goes.
- [3 BHK interior design in Pune](https://twinspacestudios.com/services/3-bhk-interior-design): what a full 3 BHK costs and how to plan the third room.

## Areas served

- [Areas we serve across Pune and PCMC](https://twinspacestudios.com/areas-we-serve): the twenty areas we work in, with local housing context for each.
- [Interior designers in Baner](https://twinspacestudios.com/areas/baner): 3 BHK, 4 BHK and duplex homes; society and service-lift rules, and the three sides of Baner.
- [Interior designers in Kothrud](https://twinspacestudios.com/areas/kothrud): Established societies, renovation with the family in residence, Paud Road redevelopment.
- [Interior designers in Balewadi](https://twinspacestudios.com/areas/balewadi): Gated townships near Balewadi High Street; opening the kitchen wall in a builder 2 BHK.
- [Interior designers in Kharadi](https://twinspacestudios.com/areas/kharadi): New-possession towers near EON IT Park and WTC; preparing before you collect the keys.
- [Interior designers in Punawale](https://twinspacestudios.com/areas/punawale): Complete 2 BHK fit-outs from a bare builder handover, split into move-in and deferred scope.
- [Interior designers in Kondhwa](https://twinspacestudios.com/areas/kondhwa): Larger-format 3 and 4 BHK homes on NIBM Road; zoning and multi-generational specifications.
- [Interior designers in Wakad](https://twinspacestudios.com/areas/wakad): Fifteen years of stock in one area; congestion scheduling and buildings without a service lift.
- [Interior designers in Hinjawadi](https://twinspacestudios.com/areas/hinjawadi): IT-park housing; two people working from home, and letting versus living specifications.
- [Interior designers in Aundh](https://twinspacestudios.com/areas/aundh): An old core and new towers side by side; narrow lanes that a delivery truck cannot enter.
- [Interior designers in Mahalunge](https://twinspacestudios.com/areas/mahalunge): Our own neighbourhood; new-possession fit-out done in the right order.
- [Interior designers in Sus](https://twinspacestudios.com/areas/sus): Hillside outlook, new build, and approach roads that are still arriving.
- [Interior designers in Bavdhan](https://twinspacestudios.com/areas/bavdhan): Larger flats on the hillside toward NDA Road; designing a big room so it is not empty.
- [Interior designers in Pashan](https://twinspacestudios.com/areas/pashan): Academic and research households; library walls, real studies, and restrained finishes.
- [Interior designers in Erandwane](https://twinspacestudios.com/areas/erandwane): Core old Pune where access is the defining constraint; renovation with the family in residence.
- [Interior designers in Tathawade](https://twinspacestudios.com/areas/tathawade): Compact PCMC 2 BHKs from bare handover; storage planning and letting specifications.
- [Interior designers in Koregaon Park](https://twinspacestudios.com/areas/koregaon-park): Low-rise and bungalow stock; restoring what is there rather than boxing it in.
- [Interior designers in Viman Nagar](https://twinspacestudios.com/areas/viman-nagar): Designing around aircraft noise, and fitting out for letting.
- [Interior designers in Kalyani Nagar](https://twinspacestudios.com/areas/kalyani-nagar): Compact premium riverside flats; humidity, materials and second-round renovation.
- [Interior designers in Mundhwa](https://twinspacestudios.com/areas/mundhwa): Keshav Nagar high-rise; societies that are still writing their fit-out rules.
- [Interior designers in Hadapsar](https://twinspacestudios.com/areas/hadapsar): Three different Hadapsars, township bye-laws, and an honest lower-budget scope.
- [Interior designers in Magarpatta City](https://twinspacestudios.com/areas/magarpatta-city): The strictest township rules in Pune, and what they will not let you change.

Also covers Pimple Saudagar, Wagholi, Ravet and Moshi across PCMC.

## Guides for homeowners

- [All guides](https://twinspacestudios.com/guides): costs, timelines, society rules and materials, with real numbers.
- [What interior design costs in Pune](https://twinspacestudios.com/guides/interior-design-cost-pune): 2 BHK INR 12-16 lakh, 3 BHK INR 16-21 lakh, 4 BHK and duplex INR 22-35 lakh, and where the budget goes.
- [2 BHK interior cost in Pune](https://twinspacestudios.com/guides/2-bhk-interior-cost-pune): Room-by-room breakdown, what to protect and what to defer on a tight budget.
- [3 BHK interior cost in Pune](https://twinspacestudios.com/guides/3-bhk-interior-cost-pune): Room-by-room breakdown, and how to decide what the third bedroom is for.
- [Modular kitchen cost in Pune](https://twinspacestudios.com/guides/modular-kitchen-cost-pune): INR 2-7 lakh by size; why the carcass, hardware and ducted chimney matter most.
- [Wardrobe cost in Pune](https://twinspacestudios.com/guides/wardrobe-cost-pune): Priced per square foot of elevation; sliding versus openable, and internal layout.
- [False ceiling and lighting cost in Pune](https://twinspacestudios.com/guides/false-ceiling-cost-pune): Per-square-foot rates, and where we recommend not having a ceiling at all.
- [The costs people forget to budget for](https://twinspacestudios.com/guides/hidden-costs-interior-design): Society deposits, material handling, bathrooms, appliances, and the two questions to ask.
- [How an interior project actually runs](https://twinspacestudios.com/guides/interior-design-process): The six stages, what each needs from you, and where projects really go wrong.
- [How long a home interior takes](https://twinspacestudios.com/guides/interior-design-timeline): Ten to twelve weeks week by week, and the three real causes of delay.
- [How payments are staged](https://twinspacestudios.com/guides/interior-design-payment-schedule): Milestone-based stages, and what to watch for in any payment schedule.
- [Society rules for interior work in Pune](https://twinspacestudios.com/guides/society-rules-interior-work-pune): Working hours, lift bookings, deposits, and what societies will not permit.
- [What to check before interior work starts](https://twinspacestudios.com/guides/new-flat-possession-checklist): The snag list to hand the builder while the fixes are still free.
- [Plywood, laminate and materials explained](https://twinspacestudios.com/guides/plywood-and-materials): What MR, BWR and BWP mean and where each belongs in a Pune home.
- [Renovating an older flat in Pune](https://twinspacestudios.com/guides/renovation-vs-new-flat): What to survey before quoting, what to keep, and how the budget lands differently.
- [Living in the flat during a renovation](https://twinspacestudios.com/guides/living-in-during-renovation): Phasing, dust control, and what it adds to the programme.

## Completed projects

- [3 BHK duplex, Baner](https://twinspacestudios.com/projects/baner-duplex): marble, teak slats and brass carried across two levels.
- [3 BHK, Dahanukar Colony, Kothrud](https://twinspacestudios.com/projects/kothrud-3bhk): art-led home with a pooja unit at the entry and a window study nook.
- [4 BHK, Escon, Kondhwa](https://twinspacestudios.com/projects/kondhwa-4bhk): dining under a slatted timber ceiling in an open plan.
- [3 BHK, Kharadi](https://twinspacestudios.com/projects/kharadi-3bhk): arched detailing repeated from foyer to guest bedroom.
- [2 BHK, Balewadi](https://twinspacestudios.com/projects/balewadi-2bhk): kitchen opened into the living room.
- [2 BHK, Punawale](https://twinspacestudios.com/projects/punawale-2bhk): living and dining planned together from a bare handover.
